observations: Photo 0 shows a hand holding a rectangular, dark gray object wrapped in plastic.
The object has a sticker on top with 'PS4 SLIM' in large red letters.
The sticker also includes images of three different console models and text about 'CHIPS AND CHIPSETS TECHNOLOGIES'.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the front of the object, below the sticker.
The object appears to be a console, but it is fully wrapped in plastic, so no ports, buttons, or other details are visible.
The background is a dark, patterned surface, possibly a curtain or wall.

claims.claim: Perfect console for your home entertainment
claims.evidence: No functional test or condition details are visible; the console is wrapped in plastic and no internal components or ports are shown.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or damaged internally.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the console powered on, with the front panel, ports, and disc tray visible, and ideally a video of it booting up.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, ideally from the back or bottom, and a photo of the power brick and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or unbranded unit

risks.risk: The console may be missing essential components (e.g., power cable, HDMI cable, controller).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the console's back or bottom showing the model and serial number.
A photo of the console powered on, showing the boot screen or home menu.
A photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller, etc.).
A video of the console booting up and playing a game or showing the home screen.
response.reason: The console is fully wrapped in plastic, and no functional or physical details are visible. The identity is based on a sticker, which may not reflect the actual product. Without proof of functionality, accessories, and authenticity, a price cannot be determined.
